scope: Fresh synthetic signals only; no public evaluation or private speech
region_rule: Frequency regions are bounded by adjacent known-pole midpoints and 50/5450 Hz. Their emptiness diagnoses candidate loss, not anatomical identity on natural speech.

fixed_example_cutoff_check.interpretation: Both signals have F0=400 Hz. If conflict is true, a cutoff depending only on bandwidth and F0 cannot retain a candidate in the known resonance region while rejecting these extra candidates at the two recorded frames.
